notes: Evaluates CADENCE turn capture, secret redaction, external storage, SFT/DPO/RLVR export, and client-isolation guarantees.

evals.name: hook-capture-redact-idempotent
evals.prompt: Trigger cadence-turn-logger.sh Stop hook on an Antigravity transcript containing secrets and verify redacted external logging and cursor idempotency.
evals.expected_output: Captures turn outside git repo with 0600 permissions, redacts secrets, and second invocation writes zero duplicate rows.
assertions: Writes turn log outside repo into CADENCE_TURN_LOG_DIR with 0600 mode
Redacts API tokens before writing to disk
Skips duplicate capture when Stop fires again on identical step_index

check.cmd: export CADENCE_TURN_LOG_DIR="$FIX/ext_logs"; inp=$(python3 -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"conversationId":"conv-eval","workspacePaths":[sys.argv[1]],"transcriptPath":sys.argv[2],"terminationReason":"NO_TOOL_CALL"}))' "$FIX" "$FIX/agy_conv/transcript_full.jsonl"); out1=$(printf '%s' "$inp" | bash "$ROOT/hooks/cadence-turn-logger.sh"); printf '%s' "$inp" | bash "$ROOT/hooks/cadence-turn-logger.sh" >/dev/null; echo "$out1"; cnt=$(cat "$FIX"/ext_logs/repos/*/*/*.turns.jsonl | wc -l); echo "rows=$cnt"; ! grep -q 'ghp_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' "$FIX"/ext_logs/repos/*/*/*.turns.jsonl

evals.name: export-sft-dpo-rlvr-and-verify
evals.prompt: Capture failed then verified-pass turns, export sft/dpo/rlvr datasets, and validate each with trainlog.sh verify.
evals.expected_output: Produces valid SFT, DPO, and RLVR JSONL files passing verify with zero secrets.
assertions: Pairs gate_failed turn followed by verified_pass turn into a DPO chosen/rejected sample
Passes trainlog.sh verify for sft, dpo, and rlvr exports

check.cmd:
export CADENCE_TURN_LOG_DIR="$FIX/ext_logs"; python3 -B - "$ROOT" "$FIX" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) / "hooks"))
import cadence_turn_logger as ctl
import cadence_turn_parsers as ctp
fix = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
steps = [json.loads(l) for l in (fix / "tr/t1.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
for seq, sl in enumerate((steps[:4], steps[4:]), start=1):
    msgs, mdls, usg = ctp.parse_antigravity_steps(sl, 16000)
    ctl.build_and_append_turn(fix / "ext_logs", fix, "antigravity", "s1", seq, [sl[0]["step_index"], sl[-1]["step_index"]], msgs, mdls, usg, sl[0]["created_at"])
PY
repo=$(basename "$(ls -d "$FIX"/ext_logs/repos/* | head -n1)"); for f in sft dpo rlvr; do bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-trainlog/trainlog.sh" export --log-dir "$FIX/ext_logs" --format "$f" --repo "$repo" --out "$FIX/out-$f.jsonl" && bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-trainlog/trainlog.sh" verify --input "$FIX/out-$f.jsonl"; done
stdout_regex: PASS: verify records=1 format=dpo avg_chars=\d+ secrets=0
PASS: verify records=2 format=sft avg_chars=\d+ secrets=0
PASS: verify records=2 format=rlvr avg_chars=\d+ secrets=0

evals.name: chinese-wall-blocks-cross-client-mix
evals.prompt: Attempt to export a single dataset combining two differently tagged client-restricted repositories.
evals.expected_output: Exits 2 with CHINESE_WALL_VIOLATION without creating an output file.
assertions: Fails closed before creating output file when client-restricted repos differ in client_tag

check.cmd: rc=0; bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-trainlog/trainlog.sh" export --log-dir "$FIX/ext" --format sft --allow-multi-repo --repos cook-and-james,grec --out "$FIX/blocked.jsonl" || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc"; test "$rc" -eq 2 && test ! -e "$FIX/blocked.jsonl"
